Description: Improved the sessionStorage restore logic to prevent race conditions and unnecessary re-renders. The restore now runs only once per mount (tracked via ref), and the condition for detecting "no active params" properly handles default values. Also added a `useRef` flag to prevent the scroll-restore effect from firing on every products array change.
Instruction: Improve the sessionStorage restore logic and scroll position restore to be more robust. Use a ref to track if restore has already happened to prevent double-firing.
